INDICATIONS:
3.4 cm right middle lobe cavitary lesion; history of colon cancer. Tissue diagnosis requested.
MEDICATIONS:
General anesthesia with laryngeal mask airway
IMAGING / CONFIRMATION:
DT; radial EBUS
TECHNICAL DIFFICULTY:
No
LIMITATIONS:
None
TOLERANCE:
Good after intervention
FINDINGS:
After informed consent and time-out, a therapeutic bronchoscope was introduced under general anesthesia with laryngeal mask airway. Airway inspection to the
first subsegmental level showed no obstructing endobronchial lesion. The Ion robotic platform was docked and a deliberate workflow with fluoroscopy, radial
EBUS, and cone-beam confirmation was performed. The target was a 3.4 cm lesion in the right middle lobe. Imaging confirmation used DT. Initial fluoroscopy
suggested near-target positioning. Radial probe EBUS demonstrated no clear radial image but lesion localization felt acceptable after fluoroscopic confirmation.
A cone-beam or tomographic spin was then obtained to assess tool-to-lesion relationship, after which the catheter was adjusted as needed and repeat
fluoroscopy was performed. Once tool-in-lesion or satisfactory tool-to-lesion relationship was confirmed, lesion sampling proceeded. Samples obtained included
TBNA x5; forceps biopsies x9; brushings x2; BAL x1; cryobiopsies x3. Technical difficulty: No. Limitation(s): None. Associated linear EBUS staging was then
performed. Surveyed stations included 11R (8.9 mm), 10R (7.4 mm), 10L (8.0 mm), 11Rs (9.4 mm). Sampled stations: 11R x4 (malignant cells on ROSE); 10R
x3 (negative on ROSE); 10L x4 (negative on ROSE). At the end of the case, the airway was reinspected, blood/secretions were suctioned, and there was no
active bleeding.
ESTIMATED BLOOD LOSS:
<5 mL
COMPLICATIONS:
Trace pneumothorax on post-procedure CXR, stable on repeat imaging and managed conservatively
IMPRESSION:
Successful ion robotic bronchoscopy targeting of the right middle lobe lesion. Associated EBUS staging was
performed. Minor immediate complication: trace pneumothorax on post-procedure cxr, stable on repeat imaging and
managed conservatively.
RECOMMENDATIONS:
Recover in PACU; post-procedure chest radiograph per protocol; await final pathology; integrate EBUS staging into
treatment planning

-
Left upper mediastinal adenopathy.
-
Preliminary ROSE negative for malignancy; station 2L sampling was scant.
